business_problem: VEV Romerike lacked integrated service, sales, marketing, and data workflows, so support cases moved slowly, chatbot automation underperformed, and the small team had little visibility into customer behavior or growth opportunities.
solution_summary: VEV Romerike used Salesforce Foundations to activate a connected SMB stack spanning Agentforce, Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Data Cloud without taking on the cost or complexity of a large-enterprise rollout. The telco first used Foundations to connect support systems and replace ineffective chatbot automation with a better trained service workflow that can resolve a meaningful share of cases automatically. Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud now give the team more current customer insight and targeted communication, while Sales Cloud and Service Cloud share the same account context so support interactions can feed upsell and cross-sell opportunities instead of ending in a disconnected ticket queue. For a business with fewer than 30 employees, that unified architecture creates the leverage to move faster, collaborate across departments, and grow nationally without adding manual handoffs back into service or marketing operations.
data_flow: Support interactions and customer data flow into Service Cloud and Data Cloud, Agentforce automates routine resolution, and the resulting account context is reused by Sales Cloud and Marketing Cloud for targeted communication, upsell, and cross-sell activity.
business_outcome: VEV resolved cases faster, automated a meaningful share of service work, improved internal visibility, and created a better basis for loyalty, upsell, and cross-sell with a very small operating team.
metrics: Resolving a full 30% of service cases
architecture_clues: Foundations is the enablement layer that made Agentforce, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud accessible to the team.
Service and customer-value workflows now share one connected data layer instead of separate tools.
The rollout is explicitly framed as a small-business implementation rather than an enterprise-scale transformation.
evidence_quotes: VEV Romerike is a small Norwegian telecommunications company with less than 30 employees.
Foundations is a free add-on available to every enterprise Salesforce customer.
Automation is now effectively resolving a full 30% of service cases.
With Foundations and Agentforce, VEV is resolving service cases 40% faster.
